where: A rough-hewn cave under the city where the tunnel splits into two forks of dripping stone, a cold mist drifting out of them. Crystal-set runes glow faintly blue in the walls. The party stands in the cave; Eamon studies the runes on the east wall while Lady Astrid looks down the left-hand fork. The right fork runs off into darkness; the left bends twice and ends at a blank, seamless wall.
